name: japan-travel
description: Source guidance and read-only tools for planning travel in Japan: destinations, weather, rail/bus routes, seasonal viewing, hotels, rail passes and restaurants.

interface.longDescription: Thirteen skills for Japan travel research: destinations, weather, rail/bus routes, seasonal viewing, hotels, passes and restaurants. Official source guides cover fourteen destinations, including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Sapporo, Fukuoka and the original Hokuriku/Nagano cities; other coverage varies by skill. Requires local Python and outbound HTTPS; see skill requirements. Anonymous, read-only results with source links and explicit unknowns. No reservations or purchases.
